title: Service Charge History — Modified By column renders a raw GUID instead of a display name
requirementSource: NM-2210 AC-4 — History tab must show 'Modified by · Modified on' (who made each change); a raw GUID does not identify the actor in a human-readable form
stepsToReproduce: Navigate to Location Settings → Service Charge for any office (e.g. office 1604 or 1101).
Click the Service Charge History tab and wait for the data grid to populate.
Read the Modified By column values in any visible row.
expectedBehavior: Each Modified By cell should show a human-readable identifier for who made the change — the old-site equivalent column shows 'System Update' for migrated rows; person names or emails are expected for user-authored changes.
actualBehavior: All ten sampled rows on 2026-08-11 for office 1604 rendered raw GUID strings (e.g. '0c0bec78-1b63-4eed-a2ea-967920c8bfc3', 'b5668cc9-…', '156d03e1-…'). Three distinct GUIDs appeared across the ten sampled rows. GUID scope across the full 50-row set is unknown from artifacts — only the first ten rows were sampled.
mcpEvidence: Walk 2026-08-11 nm3344-histwalk2-0811 (office 1604, 50 rows): MCP_VERIFICATION_LOG item 9 — 'Modified By renders raw GUID — Confirmed across all ten sampled rows — no name or email appears.' service_charge_history_test_cases.md Validation Rules row: 'Known defect: all sampled rows on 2026-08-11 rendered a raw GUID (0c0bec78-…, b5668cc9-…, 156d03e1-…) instead of a display name; no ticket covering this was found.'
baselineEvidence: nav2-observations.md (2026-08-11) § Modified By — Three verbatim values: all ~30+ visible rows on the old site show 'System Update'. New site shows raw GUIDs for the same column. Old-site baseline walk: office 1101, navigator2.training.psav.com/#/setup/serviceCharge.

verificationLog.finding: GUID vs email scope clarification: the 10 GUID rows sampled on 2026-08-11 (all pre-existing rows from before today) continue to render raw GUIDs. However, new rows created on 2026-08-11 by the automation account render an email address ('s-prd-clickauto@psav.com') rather than a GUID. The GUID rendering therefore affects pre-existing/legacy rows only; rows authored by the current automation user show an email. Severity and impact for the legacy rows are unchanged. Bug scope amended to reflect this: the defect is that legacy rows render raw GUIDs that are not human-readable, while newly created rows render the automation account email.
